name: Embedded Sensor Subsystem (Prototype's 30 names)
description: The 30 identifiers from engine/symtab_demo.c, written as a small embedded C file.

name: UART Driver (Functions Reuse Locals)
description: Every function declares i, count and tmp again. A trie stores each repeated name once; hash tables copy it per declaration.

name: CAN Bus & Motor Subsystem (High Redundancy)
description: Heavily partitioned embedded device with repeated subsystem prefixes (can_*, motor_*, telemetry_*).

name: Lexical Scoping & Shadowing
description: Nested blocks, a for-loop scope, parameters and a shadowed global: watch how each use resolves.

name: Disjoint Identifiers (Worst-Case)
description: Identifiers with unique initial characters: almost no prefix to share, so the trie's node cost is not repaid.

name: Arduino Uno Demo (50 Embedded Globals)
description: 50 subsystem_field globals. Run it on the Uno: the textbook table runs out of RAM, the compressed table holds all 50.
